name: Stonard
summary: In the southern Swamp of Sorrows, Stonard holds a fortified Horde foothold. The outpost dates to the First War and watches the Blasted Lands from the marsh.

sections.title: A Relic of the First War
sections.body: Stonard began as an Old Horde post in the marsh beyond the Dark Portal. When the invaders crossed into what was then the Black Morass, Stonard and Rockard anchored their lines. Both posts were damaged and abandoned after the Second War. Thrall's New Horde rebuilt Stonard and placed a garrison there. Its Great Hall and fortified burrows now hold a Horde presence amid the dangerous swamp.

sections.title: Frontier Outpost
sections.body: Scouts and cartographers range from Stonard into the surrounding swamp. They chart its waters and watch for hostile beasts, lost draenei wanderers, and the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar to the east. North of the shattered Blasted Lands, the outpost also gives the Horde a staging ground. The dormant Dark Portal remains under watch.

faq.q: Why is Stonard important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Stonard gives the Horde a fortified base in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. Its scouts chart the dangerous Swamp of Sorrows, and its garrison provides a staging ground for assaults on the nearby Sunken Temple. The outpost also keeps Horde forces close to the Blasted Lands.
Stonard dates to the First War, when the Old Horde founded it after crossing the Dark Portal. The outpost fell into disuse after the Second War. Thrall's New Horde later rebuilt it.

faq.q: What happened to its sister settlement, Rockard?
faq.answer: Rockard was founded alongside Stonard during the First War, and together the posts anchored the Old Horde's lines in the swamp. The New Horde rebuilt Stonard, but Rockard's fate since the wars is not recorded.

faq.q: Can you fly or travel directly to Stonard?
faq.answer: Yes. Stonard's flight paths connect it to Kargath, Flame Crest, Grom'gol Base Camp, Booty Bay, and Rog'mar in the Riverglades.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can find guidance and training at Stonard, a Horde shaman enclave in the southern Eastern Kingdoms, far from Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Stonard as your fortified outpost between the Badlands to the north and Stranglethorn Vale to the west.
